decision: Invalidate initial Open Images training runs before development evaluation
reason: Post-fit TRAIN label audit found crop5, a large unmatched proposal, includes distant blue balloons. Low box IoU did not establish background. A crop-to-annotation overlap check also identifies other unmatched candidates requiring conservative exclusion.
next_action: Correct visual review and exclude every unmatched background crop overlapping a source balloon annotation. Retain source-object crops explicitly reviewed as non-target classes. Start both seeds and matched controls fresh from the same unchanged parent, using a new clean run prefix.
